criterion: Exactly one red ball visibly moves left to right while retaining a broadly round shape in the inspected keyframes. This narrow visual task does not score every prompt detail, flicker or overall model quality.
method: Human visual review of six-keyframe contact sheets, all three measured seeds; no real-time playback claim. WebM retains49frames; WebP may coalesce repeats. Supported by an HSV red-blob check over all 49 decoded frames.

One ball at the left of the table stays nearly still
One round red ball enters from the left edge and rolls steadily to the right (red-blob x 0.01→0.67)
